name: Anthropic
tagline: Building AI that’s actually good for humanity.
rundown: Anthropic is a rising star in the AI space, focused on developing large language models like Claude with a serious emphasis on safety and beneficial outcomes. Founded by former OpenAI folks, they're tackling the tricky questions around AI alignment – ensuring these powerful systems behave predictably and ethically. With a massive valuation and ambitious plans for an IPO, Anthropic is poised to play a major role in shaping the future of AI.

timeline.event: Founded by Daniela and Dario Amodei, former OpenAI researchers.
Released Claude 1, their initial large language model.
Launched Claude 2, significantly improving performance and capabilities.
Expanded access to Claude via API and partnerships.
Continued development focused on Constitutional AI – training models based on ethical principles.

notableFacts: Founded by siblings who previously worked at OpenAI.
Anthropic is structured as a public benefit corporation, prioritizing societal good alongside profit.
They've achieved an estimated valuation of $965 billion, making them the most valuable pure-play AI company.
Their 'Constitutional AI' approach aims to build more aligned and reliable language models.
